notes:
Titles and DOIs verified in retrieved primary full texts. PDF text extraction renders some original-paper equals signs as !; statistics transcribed as printed numeric values without conversion. The original reports a Mann–Whitney U statistic and p, but no standardized effect size for this test. Requested d is therefore null; no conversion performed. The replication uses a t test and a floor cross instead of the original colander target.
Completion source review (es_value_o): The critical Study 2 between-condition result prints Mann–Whitney U = 90.5 (same-test p = .02). Requested d is not printed; the printed test statistic is retained without conversion, with its metric identified.
Completion source review (n_r): Experiment 3 explicitly reports 118 recruited participants and no exclusions from the primary distance-thrown analysis. The 24 movement cases are excluded only in separately labelled exploratory sensitivity analyses.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly state that Experiment 3 did not replicate the original beanbag-throwing finding; verdict is narrative, not inferred from p.
